Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Unlike the fractious, often indolent @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} are fervent supporters of their sect, channeling their clan's revolutionary fire directly into the Sword of Caine's cause. They favor direct, hands-on action over political maneuvering, throwing themselves into brawls and raids rather than backroom influence games.

Disciplines: Celerity, Potence, Presence

Advantage: All Brujah gain one free level of Political, University or Street Influence, and an associated Ability of Politics, Academics or Streetwise.

Disadvantage: Brujah are easily prone to violence and frenzy. All Brujah suffer a one-Trait penalty on Virtue Tests of Self-Control/Instinct.

Organization: Sabbat Brujah cluster informally around packs and causes that let them act on their convictions, providing much of the muscle and zeal that drives the sect's crusades.
